seen.v003: A ground-based telescope emits a bright yellow laser beam into the night sky, which features the glowing band of the Milky Way galaxy filled with countless stars.
seen.v005: A deep space field captured by the James Webb Space Telescope, displaying numerous distant galaxies, gravitational lensing arcs, and bright foreground stars with distinct diffraction spikes.
seen.v013: A spiral galaxy viewed from above, showcasing a prominent central bar, glowing core, and winding spiral arms dotted with star clusters against the blackness of space.
seen.v017: An astronomical image titled 'The Coma Cluster of galaxies', showing a dense collection of numerous galaxy shapes against a dark background, with text and a small emblem at the bottom.
seen.v019: A black-and-white portrait of physicist Albert Einstein, looking directly at the camera with characteristic unruly white hair and a thoughtful expression.
seen.v021: A dense globular star cluster densely packed with thousands of glowing stars of various colors, mostly concentrated towards the center.
seen.v023: An image of interacting galaxies known as the Antennae Galaxies, showing two large galaxies colliding with bright pink star-forming regions and long tidal tails of stars and gas.
seen.v028: An amateur telescope rig mounted on a tripod under a starry night sky, with various cables, a red tracking light, and a silhouette of tree branches in the foreground.
seen.v032: The Ring Nebula, a planetary nebula appearing as an oval ring of glowing colorful gas with a hot blue center and a dark void in the middle, set against a black background.
seen.v034: An oval-shaped all-sky map of the cosmic microwave background radiation, displaying temperature fluctuations across the early universe in shades of blue, orange, and tan.
seen.v042: A dimly lit control room or operations center filled with computer monitors displaying various data and graphs, with two people seated at desks working.
seen.v047: A full view of planet Earth from space, showing the continent of Africa, swirling white cloud patterns over the oceans, and the blue atmosphere against a black background.
seen.v055: A composite space image featuring a distorted spiral galaxy shaped somewhat like a question mark, surrounded by numerous green and white foreground and background stars.
seen.v058: A deep field image of space showing a vast collection of distant galaxies of various shapes, sizes, and colors, along with several brighter stars featuring prominent diffraction spikes.
seen.v069: A landscape photograph of a calm body of water at sunset, with a golden sun casting a reflection on the water, silhouetted grass on a beach in the foreground, and a warm orange sky.
seen.v070: A portion of the Carina Nebula known as the 'Mystic Mountain', showing pillars of cosmic dust and gas illuminated by newborn stars, with a black rectangular placeholder area in the bottom left.
seen.v072: A dense star field filled with countless bright blue-white stars scattered uniformly across a dark space background.
seen.v086: A scientific simulation visualization of cosmic filaments and the large-scale structure of the universe, represented as bright branching tendrils of light with a red marker point.
seen.v088: A wide-angle night sky photograph filled with stars, featuring the silhouette of dark tree canopies along the bottom edge.
